stats.title.note: Page and window title for points and completion history.

stats.empty.title.note: Empty statistics state before any readable record.

stats.empty.body.text: After your first run, your points and daily progress will appear here.
stats.empty.body.note: Friendly empty-state explanation, no fabricated zero history.

stats.account.note: Scope selector shown only when more than one account exists.

stats.account.all.note: Combined scope over current active and paused accounts, not a comparison table.

stats.range.note: Accessible label for the range radio group.

stats.week.note: Producer-calculated points since the regional first weekday.

stats.streak.title.note: App-defined core completion streak, not Microsoft's official streak.

stats.calendar.title.note: Completion calendar heading. No fewer/more points scale.

stats.calendar.day.note: Accessible day button label. date and state are already localized strings.

stats.state.done.note: Readable daily set and search quota both complete.

stats.state.today_open.note: Today only, readable core work still open or not yet checked. Never a missed-day failure.

stats.state.missed.note: Past readable day with core work left open.

stats.state.no_check.note: Date after tracking started without a readable core result, not a failed day.

stats.state.before_tracking.note: Calendar date before any account observations, not a missed day.

stats.sources.day.note: Heading of the task-points panel for the calendar's selected date, not the date range. date is already regionally formatted. Hover or focus previews do not change this selection.

stats.sources.day_empty.text: No task totals for this day
stats.sources.day_empty.note: One short line in the selected-date task panel when that day's sources.runs is zero. No task rows or invented zero task values; the day's known overall earnings remain visible on the left.

stats.day.points.note: Compact known earned and possible point counts. Both are regionally formatted; a percentage follows only when possible is positive. Omit unknown values.

stats.day.runs.note: Accessible name of selected-day run links. Checks appear only in History.

stats.warning.ledger_rebuilt.text: Your stats were rebuilt from the run details still available. Some earlier days may be missing.
stats.warning.ledger_rebuilt.note: Ledger recovery could preserve only evidence still retained, not complete lifetime history.

stats.warning.ledger_newer.text: These stats were saved by a newer app. Only available run details are shown until the app is updated.
stats.warning.ledger_newer.note: Future ledger schema is not overwritten or downgraded.

stats.chart.help.text: Use Left and Right to inspect dates, Home for the first day and End for the latest. Missing values stay unavailable.
stats.chart.help.note: Keyboard chart help shared by Stats and Overview; arrows follow the mirrored RTL timeline.
